limits: Translation aligns matching displayed events only, assumes equal local time scale, and is a conditional diagnostic; it is not a verified whole-video time warp.
Bracket ranges propagate annotation endpoints. They omit unknown differences between input-overlay and game display latency; they are not confidence intervals or proven engine bounds.
Repeated images widen first-Effect uncertainty. First-hit readiness onset and all late input failure boundaries are unobserved.
Ordinary solid-yellow readiness is distinct from contact/recovery gold/orange pulses and is not a proven physical-key gate.
Button gray after a successful press may be caused by that action. It cannot establish the latest acceptable press without another observation.
The baseline windows are a snapshot of the provisional R2 service chart, not recovered game windows. Mean width is an unadopted comparison only.
